prompt: As of 2024, what is the street address of the headquarters of the American online video sharing platform that was launched in the same year as the founding of the Vancouver Cherry Blossom festival?
answer: As of 2024, the headquarters address was **901 Cherry Avenue, San Bruno, California, United States**. The platform is **YouTube**, launched in 2005—the same year the Vancouver Cherry Blossom Festival was founded.
